import hashlib,hmac,base64,json
from pathlib import Path
username='ZZZZZZZZ,=user';password=b'ZZZZZZZZ-password';nonce='ZZZZZZZZ-nonce'
first_bare=('n='+username.replace('=','=3D').replace(',','=2C')+',r='+nonce).encode()
server_first=b'r=ZZZZZZZZ-nonce-server,s=c2FsdA==,i=4096'
final_bare=b'c=biws,r=ZZZZZZZZ-nonce-server'
auth=first_bare+b','+server_first+b','+final_bare
mac=lambda key,msg:hmac.new(key,msg,hashlib.sha256).digest()
salted=hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac('sha256',password,b'salt',4096)
client_key=mac(salted,b'Client Key');client_signature=mac(hashlib.sha256(client_key).digest(),auth)
proof=bytes(a^b for a,b in zip(client_key,client_signature));server_signature=mac(mac(salted,b'Server Key'),auth)
first=b'n,,'+first_bare;final=final_bare+b',p='+base64.b64encode(proof);server_final=b'v='+base64.b64encode(server_signature)
fixture=b'\n'.join([first,final,server_final])+b'\n'
p=Path('/Users/froran/Projects/private/charlotte-os/tests/transport/fixtures/scram-initial-reference.txt');p.write_bytes(fixture)
